bio: In an excellent location next to the Retiro park, Alabaster is home to a gastro-bar with high tables for an informal supper, an impressive glass-fronted wine cellar, and a spacious dining room complemented by two private spaces. Here, the emphasis is on updated seasonal and traditional cuisine, with the à la carte divided into two parts (Comparte and Disfruta). There’s also a tasting menu option named after the restaurant. Dishes include grilled scallops with a bone marrow emulsion and breadcrumbs; Galician stew ravioli with an “ajada” sauce and fried cabbage; and hake with a lemon pil-pil sauce and spinach....
